name: TRIBE Bali Legian
short_description: A 113-room TRIBE lifestyle hotel in Legian, Bali, opening August 2026, featuring the Folk and Fare restaurant and Chill Out SPA.
ai_summary: TRIBE Bali Legian is a 113-room lifestyle hotel under Accor's TRIBE brand, scheduled to open in August 2026. Located in Legian between Kuta and Seminyak, it will be one of the first TRIBE properties in Bali. The hotel features the brand's signature design-led, community-focused approach with a Folk and Fare restaurant and a Chill Out SPA on site. TRIBE is positioned as an affordable lifestyle brand at the intersection of hostel social energy and boutique hotel aesthetics — curated interiors, flexible communal workspaces, and a focus on value without sacrificing design. The Legian location places guests within walking distance or a short scooter ride of Legian Beach and the dining and nightlife corridors of both Legian and Seminyak. As a pre-opening property, there are no guest reviews or established service patterns yet — all assessment is based on the TRIBE brand proposition and the hotel's stated facilities. For ALL Accor elite members, standard programme benefits are expected: welcome drink for Silver and above, room upgrades for Platinum and Diamond subject to availability, and early check-in and late check-out for Diamond.

faqs.question: Is TRIBE Bali Legian open yet?
faqs.answer: The hotel is scheduled to open in August 2026. At the time of this research it is in pre-opening status, and there are no guest reviews available. Prospective guests should verify the hotel's operational status on the Accor ALL website or app before booking.
